metaDescription: Offer your time to guide a new Muslim. Tell us a little about you and our team will be in touch.
title: Volunteer as a mentor
lead: Help someone who is new to Islam feel less alone.
intro: A mentor is a friendly, experienced Muslim who answers questions and encourages a new Muslim along the way. We match you with someone, and you talk by email.
signInBody: You need an account to volunteer. After you sign in, you will come right back here.
verifyBody: We need a confirmed email address before you can apply.
loadError: We could not load this page. Try again.
pendingBody: Thank you. Our team will read it and email you soon.
approvedBody: Thank you for giving your time. You can see your mentees on your mentor page.
declinedBody: Thank you for offering. We are not able to accept your application right now. If you have questions, we would love to hear from you.
successBody: Thank you. Our team will read it and email you soon.
aboutLabel: Why do you want to help?
experienceHint: How long you have been Muslim, what you have studied, any experience helping others.
availabilityHint: For example, a few evenings a week.
genderHint: We match mentors and new Muslims of the same gender.
guideline1: Be gentle and patient. Everyone starts somewhere.
guideline2: Keep every conversation respectful and appropriate between men and women, and stay with the same gender.
guideline3: Do not give rulings beyond your knowledge. Point people to a scholar.
guideline4: Protect their privacy. What they share stays with you.
agreeLabel: I have read the guidelines and agree to follow them.
errorAbout: Tell us why you want to help.
errorExperience: Tell us a little about your background.
errorAvailability: Tell us when you are available.
errorAgree: Please agree to the guidelines to continue.
errorEmailUnverified: Please confirm your email address before you apply.
errorRateLimited: Too many tries. Please wait a little and try again.
